rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Structure ladder in one line each: primary = amino-acid sequence; secondary = H-bonded α-helix/β-sheet; tertiary = full 3-D fold (disulphide, ionic, H-bonds); quaternary = several subunits (haemoglobin: 4).  ·  Trick 2: Zwitterion: at the isoelectric point the amino acid carries both NH3+ and COO− — explains high melting points and amphoteric behaviour.
